title: Sports Illustrated Old Faces In New Places March 16, 1981 - Rollie Fingers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Magazines
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Sports Illustrated magazine from March 16, 1981 featuring Rollie Fingers of the Milwaukee Brewers. This publication captures a moment in baseball history, showcasing Fingers during his time with the Brewers. A great addition for collectors or fans of vintage sports memorabilia, this magazine offers a glimpse into the past and a piece of iconic baseball history.
